field.label: Enabled
field.help: Switch off to stop blocking this game's servers at the next sync.

field.label: Name
field.help: The game's name, as the list shows it.

field.label: Hosts
field.help: The game's server names. While a device is denied gaming they are looked up every minute and the game's own addresses are blocked. Names on shared hosting services are refused.

field.label: Proxy hosts
field.help: Names reached through a provider's per-application proxy, such as Cloudflare Spectrum, which gives the name an address of its own. Leave empty unless the game uses one.

field.label: Address ranges
field.help: Public IPv4 networks the game uses, such as 192.0.2.0/24. Ranges that overlap shared services are refused.
